release_notes: Bugfix release porting the tester's addendum III — the part of that report targeting this repository. His fork-only work (a themed dialog component, Cloudflare zone automation, the click-spill file) stays out. Domain Management: Import from Namecheap works again (onClick passed the React event as an account id, so the request never left the browser — now guarded by a typeof check); opening and saving a domain no longer resets its SSL configuration (the edit modal never loaded ssl_source/custom certificate paths, and Save wrote the defaults over the stored values); ssl_source is now the single source of truth for the SSL mode — the Cloudflare button no longer lights up alongside Let's Encrypt, the proxy toggle and the mode buttons keep each other in step, and Custom clears the proxy; the certificate source is labelled beside the SSL status icon instead of hiding in the tooltip; the toolbar wraps as a unit and Check DNS is themed like every other control. The Cloudflare proxy toggle now actually changes the DNS record at Cloudflare: save_domain reads the previous flag before the UPDATE, calls upsertDnsRecord on a real change, clears the cached DNS status afterwards and reports the outcome as cloudflare_sync — previously it rewrote only the database row while the record kept its orange cloud, and the next queue run flipped the flag back. Error messages at 38 catch sites across the panel show the real error instead of a constant 'network error'. Backend: one contended SQLite write no longer aborts the whole hourly SSL queue run; the Namecheap, Cloudflare, CloudDetector and currency-rate outbound calls pin IPv4 like the ad APIs already did. A duplicate i18n key (domains.sslCloudflare was defined twice in all 7 locales — the status tooltip silently overrode the button label) is split into sslCloudflareStatus, and a sslSelfSigned label is added.
